thread:
sam: Heads-up — seeing a 6–8% throughput regression and p99 tail spike in the replay harness after the kernel-selector tweak on A100-40G images. Synthetic runs look fine. Can we sync on env parity (drivers, CUDA, kernel flags, container images) and a short protocol to repro?

julia: Ugh. Do we have the benchmark payload and exact docker image for the failing replay run?

sam: Replay run metadata attached in the harness: image=redwood/runtime:2026-03-driver-mlopt, cuda=12.1, driver=525.85, kernelflags="page-poisoning=off bigpages=on". Trace shows increased memcpy time during KV prefetch in the new kernel path.

noah: Is the synthetic traffic using the same NV driver + kernel flags? We usually run synth on a stock ubuntu:22.04 host with driver 525.85 but without the custom kernel flags.

alina: quick check — synthetic was on 525.85 + CUDA 12.1 but without bigpages set. That could change how the kernel allocator interacts with the pinned memory path.

mike: Also confirm GPU type: replay was on A100-40G (persistence mode on), synth was on A10G in the smoke cluster. That alone can mask kernel selection differences.

sam: Right — we need an apples-to-apples run (same GPU SKU, same driver, same kernel flags, same container image, and same host memory config). Proposal:
1) pick one reproducible replay trace (prod-2026-03-18-run7)
2) run replay and synthetic on A100-40G with image redwood/runtime:2026-03-driver-mlopt and driver 525.85 + CUDA 12.1
3) toggle kernelflags: (a) host default, (b) bigpages=on
4) capture nvprof / nsight system snapshots + runtime trace + kernel-selector logs
5) compare batch latency distributions and KV cache hit/miss timeline

benchbot: scheduled job 2123456792: repro-sweep-A100-mlopt (3 configs) queued on lab-cluster-3 :white_check_mark:

julia: I like that. Add a run with the previous kernel-selector (pre-change) so we can do a delta trace and isolate which kernel decision flips.

sam: Good call — add pre-change toggle. Also include `--kernelselector-log-level debug` and `--batcher-warmup 2000` to minimize cold-start noise.

noah: Small note: set environment var `REDWOOD_KV_PREFETCH=1` for both runs. The KV cache prefetch path was modified in the selector change.

alina: For reproducibility, here's the docker run snippet I used last time:
```
docker run --rm --gpus all \
  -e CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 \
  -e REDWOOD_KV_PREFETCH=1 \
  --privileged \
  --pid=host \
  -v /sys/kernel/mm:/sys/kernel/mm:ro \
  redwood/runtime:2026-03-driver-mlopt \
  ./run_bench --replay prod-2026-03-18-run7 --kernelselector pre
```

mike: Perfect. After runs finish, can we standardize the perf reporting? Suggest metrics: median throughput, p95/p99 latency, KV-prefetch latency CDF, memcpy % of token time, and kernel-choice histogram per step.

sam: Agreed. I'll collate the traces and post a diff. If we still see the regression with true parity, then it's a kernel patch bug; if not, it's env/config mismatch.

benchbot: job 2123456840: repro-sweep-A100-mlopt completed (3 configs). Artifacts: s3://bench-results/2123456810/

sam: Got the artifacts, starting diff pass now. Will summarize in ~30m :hourglass_flowing_sand:
